programme.desc: Ireland v Argentina (Kick-off 8.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the opening match in the Northern Hemisphere leg of the tournament, held at Aviva Stadium. programme.desc: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: France v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the match at Groupama Stadium in Lyon. This is the first game of the Northern Hemisphere series for both teams, and France narrowly lost to New Zealand in their first contest of the Southern Series, before recording victories over Australia and Japan. They will expect to continue their winning run against the Fijians, who have lost all three of their matches so far against Wales, England and Scotland. programme.title: Tales of Manhattan
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Julien Duvivier. Stars Charles Boyer, Rita Hayworth, Henry Fonda. An anthology of five stories revolving around a cursed tailcoat that brings misfortune to all who wear it.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, Lolo shows us how to hop, we go running in the weirdest race and go clubbing with the world's oldest transvestite.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: 2001. Adventure. Adapted by Adrian Hodges. Stars Bob Hoskins, James Fox & Elaine Cassidy. Part 2. An expedition leaves for the jungle where a man battles with dinosaurs and primitive ancestors.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher (1950)
programme.desc: 1950. Horror. A traveller arrives at Usher mansion to visit his friend Roderick (Kaye Tendeter) and discovers that Roderick and his sister (Gwen Watford) have been inflicted with a strange disease.

programme.title: Kim
programme.desc: 1960. Adventure. Director: William Asher. Narrated by Shirley Temple. Stars Michael Rennie & Joseph Wiseman. An orphan boy in India is drawn into espionage while traveling in search of truth.

programme.title: Look At Life One Horse Power
programme.desc: 1960. A look at how horses and their police riders are trained, exploring how they do their job.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Forked Lightning. 1959. Stars Ralph Nelson, Frank Maxwell & Roberta Haynes. Two men discover that their lives are intertwined by a strange psychic connection that may end up in the deaths of both.

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Donald Sinden, Anna-Maria Sandri & Anthony Steel. After the war, a young man sets out in search of his missing older brother.

programme.title: Army Days 1956
programme.desc: A charming and informative short film from 1956 showing a group of soldiers building a car, scenes from a cold winter day as they enjoy the snow and team training exercises.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Red-Headed League. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. A shopkeeper claims to have been a member of the 'Red-Headed Men' until it unexpectedly dissolved.

programme.title: Crooks Anonymous
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Directed by Ken Annakin. Stars Leslie Phillips, Stanley Baxter & Wilfrid Hyde-White. Petty thief, Dandy Forsdyke, joins an unofficial organisation for reforming criminals.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: 1950. Western. Directed by Alan Le May. Stars John Drew Barrymore, Chill Wills & John Archer. Suspicion falls upon a young drifter after a series of murders occur in the Big Bend region of Texas.

programme.title: From Here to Eternity
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Fred Zinnemann. Stars Burt Lancaster, Montgomery Clift & Deborah Kerr. A private is punished for refusing to join a boxing team. Meanwhile a torrid love affair is occurring.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1958. Print of Death. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring John Warwick, Tim Turner and Phil Brown. A payroll van is pulled over by a police car, the guards shot and the payroll stolen. (S1, E27)

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Friendship View Marriage. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Clare Richards. Mrs. Price and Wilfred come to stay. Wilfred tells Ida he's set to propose but his eye is caught elsewhere.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: The Mortgage. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada and Walter hear of a flat available for rent not too far from the church or from Leslie and Ruth's. (S3, E07)

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Dippy Blonde Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Joyce Jameson. Solo enlists the help of a THRUSH agents' girlfriend to break the criminal gang's newest operation.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks 50s style and explosive escapades.

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: Officers of the Law.1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall & Emily Richard. Kluge is anxious to clamp down on the island's black-market activities and enlists the reluctant aid of police.

programme.title: The Bargee
programme.desc: 1964. Comedy. Directed by Duncan Wood. Stars Harry H. Corbett, Hugh Griffith & Ronnie Barker. The film charts the course of love of a Casanova who lives and works on the canals, breaking hearts.

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: The Perfect Scapegoat Syndrome. 1980. Stars Peter Vaughan, Eamon Boland, Larry Lamb. Phil gets involved in university politics with unfortunate results, leading to a confrontation with his father.

programme.title: The Runaway Train
programme.desc: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts & Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read

programme.desc: The Godmother. 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Joan Sims. Glutton's Godmother, the Duchess of Durham comes to visit, and Sir John must convince her that he is married to become her heir.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Golden Fleece. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Francis De Wolff. Maigret investigates a strange accident, noticing that the men of the Paris canals do not take well to interference.

programme.title: Lillie
programme.desc: The Jersey Lily. 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Jennie Linden & Peter Egan. In London, Lillie becomes a 'Professional Beauty' and a social sensation. She also meets Oscar Wilde and Princess Louise.

programme.title: Prudence and the Pill
programme.desc: 1968. Comedy. Directed by Fielder Cook. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Niven & Judy Geeson. Five couples get involved in comical chaos when they swap birth control pills to deceive each other.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we meet The Belgian Baldmen, get squashed in a squash court, then go back to nature in Germany and meet the German Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
programme.desc: 2001. Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

programme.desc: In Hornsea, new recruit Liam joins an independent lifeboat. Can he pass the gruelling tests that will enable him to save lives at sea? In Burton Constable, we discover the remains of an ocean giant washed up on the Holderness shoreline that appears in the literary classic Moby Dick. Glampsite owners Ed and Verity create a bespoke tent with glorious views of Whitby's gothic abbey

programme.title: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
programme.desc: Following the first elimination, six applicants now remain in the process, all hoping to secure the farm tenancy. With the ewes lambing, they need to be looked after at all hours. Matt introduces the next task - hosting a farm visit for a group of schoolchildren. Giles and Sally want to see the children learning about farming, conservation and food production, and of course, the children must have fun too

programme.title: The Good Karma Hospital
programme.desc: Ram clashes with Lydia as a medical case becomes personal on the day he is due to attend a lavish wedding. Ruby treats a patient from the UK whose story does not add up, and the experience leaves her wondering where she really belongs

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team come to the aid of nonagenarian Roberta and her 86-year-old best friend and carer Enid, who live together in a retirement bungalow in Wiveliscombe, Somerset. Originally from Liverpool, the two plucky pensioners have helped each other out countless times throughout the course of their friendship, which has lasted seven decades. However, they now find themselves trapped in their home by a treacherous slope in their garden, so Alan plans to set them free by designing a future-proofed garden in a vintage style

programme.title: Real Thick Glasses
programme.desc: Soloman Watkins' quirky take as he interviews Michael, owner of the world's most unique collection of Really Thick Glasses. Funded and supported by Together TV and Cat Flap Media.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Road Trip
programme.desc: Clive has visited Rome before, but this time heads out of the centre and up one of the city's seven hills to the rarely visited neighbourhood of Monteverde, where he talks football with a butcher and puts his Caribbean cooking knowledge to good use. He also tries his hand at Italy's fastest growing sport, stays in the city's most unusual hotel and has a go at an ancient Roman art form

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Road Trip
programme.desc: The newsreader is enthusiastic about taking a dip in the vast volcanic spring of Saturnia and discovering why Italians believe in the healing power of thermal water. programme.title: The Good Karma Hospital

programme.title: Hamish Macbeth

programme.title: The Antiques Yard
programme.desc: Antiques and reclamation yard-owner Daniel Dawson-Gordon and his team reclaim, restore and repair items - bringing the unloved back to life and selling them to new homes.
